messages:
Marta: Quick check-in  can we add a `budgeted_rollout` mode that pairs feature flags with a short-term cost budget? Want console preview + a simulator mode.

Jiho: Sounds useful. API shape idea: POST /v1/rollouts { name, flag, rollout_id, mode: budgeted, budget_pct, budget_window_minutes, action_on_hit: pause|revert|notify, idempotency_key }.

Nate: Runtime comment: implement as a sliding window counter per rollout. Estimate cost per request = tokens*pool_price. Accumulate over window, compare to budget.

Marta: Console: preview heatmap with buckets (low/med/high tokens) + projected budget burn and p95 delta. Add a "simulator" checkbox to run the preview against last_15m sample without touching caches.

Jiho: Telemetry: emit rollout.simulation and rollout.step events. Include rollout_id, applied_pct, p95_before, p95_after, cost_delta_pct, sample_size, token_p50.

Nate: Quota interaction: preview must show projected quota_burn and flag if extra quota approval needed. Also note burst credits may make real cost lower than projection.

Marta: Safety leash: default to small steps (5% every 30m) when budget is present. Add an ops approval flow in console if user wants larger steps.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: queued simulation job sim-4422 for sample=last_15m, rollout=budgeted/1769456789. Will post results.

Jiho: Alerts: temp rule that auto-pauses on error_rate +0.7% absolute or p95 regression >12% for 5m. Also pause on rollout.budget_hit for >10s.

Marta: Include audit record for every budgeted rollout: user, time, rollout_id, preview_snapshot, idempotency_key. QA will validate preview vs replay within +/-20% for cost.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Simulation sim-4422 complete. Results: projected_p95_delta=+2.8%, projected_cost_delta=+9.4% (median), token_p50=38. Posted /rollout/previews/sim-4422.

Marta: Thanks. I'll write a short RFC and a tiny console PR. Will include sample body for the API: ```json
{
  "name": "prefer-low-latency-budget",
  "flag": "route_fast_pool",
  "rollout_id": "rb_2026_03_01_01",
  "mode": "budgeted",
  "budget_pct": 10,
  "budget_window_minutes": 60,
  "action_on_hit": "pause",
  "idempotency_key": "uuid-7890"
}
```

Jiho: LGTM. Add note: when cost telemetry lags >2m, halve step size until fresh data.

Marta: Good catch. I'll add that and the ops approval checkbox to the mock. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
